description.en: A comic-book store where every element is a bubble that pops on click — cheerful, saturated, cartoon outlines. The third playful-pop.
description.ko: A comic-book store where every element is a bubble that pops on click — cheerful, saturated, cartoon outlines. The third playful-pop.

provenance.en: One pop-art burst render generated in ComfyUI on the Illustrious checkpoint bismuthIllustrious_v80 at 1024x768, 28 steps, CFG 6, encoded to AVIF + WebP (~122 KB). It sits behind the title at 42% opacity — the candy explosion the wordmark pops out of. The bubble buttons stay the interactive foreground. Full recipe in PROMPT.md image-recipe.
provenance.ko: 한 장의 팝아트 버스트 렌더는 ComfyUI에서 생성 — Illustrious 계열 체크포인트 bismuthIllustrious_v80, 1024x768, 28스텝, CFG 6, AVIF + WebP 인코딩(약 122KB). 타이틀 뒤에 42% 불투명도로 앉아 있다 — 워드마크가 터져 나오는 사탕색 폭발. 버블 버튼은 인터랙티브 전경으로 남는다. 전체 레시피는 PROMPT.md의 image-recipe에.
